hypothesis: More representation capacity and routed residuals did not preserve validation. Test stochastic optimization stability under the fixed M5 dropout0.6 using two independent passes on each batch. Include a mean-task two-pass control to distinguish consistency from altered dropout sampling.
method: R-Drop-style training ablation, not a claimed novel architecture. Two independent training forwards of original M5. Mean of both full original task losses plus lambda times patient-weighted symmetric KL on either coarse3 probabilities or disease softmax probabilities. Evaluation uses exactly one original deterministic M5 forward.
training: All4arms 3 formal seeds + original patient3folds x3seeds; original loss components per view, patient weights, optimizer, hparams, fit/stop/outer partition and deterministic evaluation. No doubled optimizer steps. Both views differentiate; no teacher or new model parameters.
selection: Original patient CV Macro-F1 must exceed M5 and validation Macro-F1 must not decrease. Freeze any initial qualifier before fresh patient confirmation against M5 and fixed Gaussian. No external scoring in this study.
diagnostics: Fixed-seed paired dropout discrepancies on first256fit images per head are descriptive only. All actual checkpoints strictly load original Model with unchanged tensor schema.
external_test_policy: No external raw image, outcome or prediction access. Only development partitions used.
